text:
deploy-bot: deploy started for release/1.23.0 -> prod (schema-migration: add_user_preferences_column)

deploy-bot: migration job id=mg-7789 queued on db-prod-main shard-3
-- command: `rails db:migrate`
-- expected lock time: advisory
-- backfill: scheduled async (estimated 45m)

julia: heads-up — migration adds `user_preferences` jsonb, backfill will stream in background. leaving this here for visibility.

mike: thanks. what's the canary plan? any pinning? :eyes:

julia: canary = 10% traffic -> new model but migration is schema-only. plan was no version pin, rely on graceful fallback in app.

sara: tbh i'd prefer pin while backfill runs. last time we had a read path that expected the new key and surfaced 500s for ~2mins.

omar: agree with @sara. also we should set a DB lock threshold alert. if any migration holds advisory > 2m escalate and abort.

mike: rollback criteria proposal:
- if advisory lock > 2m and replication lag spikes > 3s -> run rollback (stop workers, revert deploy)
- if error rate on /users/* endpoints > 1% relative -> rollback

julia: noted. can we apply a short pin: routecanary=off, pin app release to previous stable for 90m? we can still allow internal traffic to exercise new code.

sara: while backfill runs, put featureflag `use_new_prefs` behind kill-switch and keep default=false. push release notes to #release-notes.

deploy-bot: migration mg-7789 started: acquiring advisory lock (pid=4521)

devops-bot: monitoring created: db-lock-watch mg-7789 threshold=120s, repl-lag-watch threshold=3s, error-rate-watch /users/* baseline=0.2%

omar: ops playbook in case lock doesn't release:
1) `pg_cancel_backend(pid)` if blocked > 120s and safe to cancel
2) if cancel fails, `kill -9` on migration pod after taking snapshot of blocking queries
3) fallback: flip featureflag and rollback app deploy

mike: are we comfortable with the snapshot step? we should capture slow query text + explain analyze.

julia: yes. add a short runbook comment in the deploy thread. i'll create a PR with the pin + featureflag update.

sara: i'll handle release notes and ops runbook blurb. include exact rollback command: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/web --to-revision=<prev>` and `rails db:rollback` is NOT safe for async backfill -> prefer app rollback + keep backfill paused.

deploy-bot: update: advisory lock acquired for 4s, continuing migration

julia: ok proceeding with a soft pin: routing config set to 95% stable, 5% internal. pin key: `release/1.22.9` for public users.

mike: please call it out in the release notes: "Public users pinned to 1.22.9 during backfill; internal QA exercising 1.23.0"

devops-bot: alert subscription: @sara, @omar, @mike (pager) for db-lock-watch events.

deploy-bot: backfill job mg-7789-stream started (estimated remaining 42m)

omar: i'll watch replication and the lock. tagging timeline: if any alert fires within next 30m, we evaluate rollback. otherwise we let backfill finish and unpin at T+90m.

sara: added release note draft and linked the runbook here: https://confluence.redwood/notes/mg-7789-runbook 

julia: thanks everyone. final decision: soft-pin public -> 1.22.9, featureflag off, ops watches in place. will unpin after backfill + post-checks. :white_check_mark:

mike: +1. good call.

deploy-bot: mg-7789 progress update: 12% rows migrated, no errors detected. next update in 10m.

(30m later)

deploy-bot: db-lock-watch triggered: advisory lock held 185s (threshold 120s) — currently blocking pid=4521

omar: looking. killing migration pod now after snapshotting blocking queries. snapshot saved -> s3://redwood-migrations/mg-7789/snap-1714204500.json

mike: abort criteria hit -> execute rollback plan from runbook. sara please start public pin enforcement and trigger app rollback.

sara: performing public pin enforcement now. triggering rollback to 1.22.9.

deploy-bot: deployment rollback initiated by sara (kubectl)

julia: keeping backfill paused. will open a follow-up postmortem to identify why the advisory lock didn't release.

devops-bot: incident ticket created INC-2026-139 for migration mg-7789, assignees: julia, omar, sara, mike

mike: after rollback, we should validate that no partial writes left the app in a bad state. i'll run sanity checks against affected endpoints.

sara: noted. will update release notes to reflect rollback and mitigation steps.

julia: thanks all. action items:
- julia: postmortem draft + timeline (due EOD)
- omar: root cause investigation on lock holder (due EOD)
- sara: release note update + incident ticket comments (in progress)
- mike: sanity checks + signoff before reattempt

deploy-bot: rollback completed. current prod version: 1.22.9.

sara: closing thread for now, will reopen if more alerts. :lock:
